description: This Java class `UpdateCenterCommandHandler` is a component in the Fineract project responsible for handling update commands for 'Center' entities. It implements the `NewCommandSourceHandler` interface, interacts with the `GroupingTypesWritePlatformService` to perform the update, and is annotated for transaction management and command type identification.

classes.name: UpdateCenterCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class handling update commands for group centers, implementing command processing logic using the specified service.

methods.name: UpdateCenterCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor injecting the write platform service dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the command to update a center, delegating the operation to the write platform service.
